text:
maya: heads-up on onboarding gpt-mini-v3 — weights are at gs://redwood-models/onboard/gpt-mini-v3/ckpt-2026-03-10. tokenizer seems to emit an extra <|sentinel|> token in the middle of multi-turn chats. Anyone seen this? Need to confirm BOS/EOS config for serving.

jon: i pulled the path earlier and verified the blob exists. there's also a model-config.yaml in that dir: gs://redwood-models/onboard/gpt-mini-v3/model-config.yaml — can someone run the config-validator?

akshay: reproduced locally. quick repro (minimal): ```py
>>> tok.encode('Hi\nUser:')
[50256, 198, 13, 50256]
```
Sentinel id 50256 shows up both as BOS-like and as a normal token when newline+User: pattern appears. looks like vocab overlap with older tokenizer vocab.

sarah: can you open an issue with the exact repro and tag eng-ml + eng-runtime? include the encoded ids and the weights path. we should also run config-validator before any PR.

maya: filing the issue now (link in thread shortly). also quick question: do we want to set explicit `bos_token` and `eos_token` in model-config or rely on runtime defaults? I'd prefer explicit to avoid surprises.

jon: explicit is safer. i'll draft a small PR to set `bos_token: '<|start|>'` and `eos_token: '<|end|>'` and add a chat_template override. diff snippet i'll include in PR: ```yaml
chat_template: "{{system}}\n{{history}}\nUser: {{input}}\nAssistant:"
bos_token: '<|start|>'
eos_token: '<|end|>'
```

config-validator-bot: config-validator: running checks on /onboard/gpt-mini-v3/model-config.yaml
- bos/eos present: NO
- reserved token collision check: WARNING (50256 used as sentinel and also appears in vocab)
- tokenizer-compat: FAIL (chat_template uses 'Assistant:' but tokenizer splits 'Assistant' and ':' separately)
Result: FAIL — see /tmp/config-validator-2391012345.log

akshay: thanks for the validator output. the root cause is the tokenizer's sentinel id landing in the normal vocab in older tokenizer files. short-term we can remap the sentinel to an unused id in the loader for this onboarding, longer-term we should update the tokenizer's special token file upstream.

maya: agree — loader remap is a pragmatic stopgap so staging tests can run. please document the remap so we don't forget when promoting to prod.

jon: will add loader remap + explicit tokens in the PR. also adding a tiny unit test for token id uniqueness to CI: ```py
assert set([tok.bos_token_id, tok.eos_token_id]).isdisjoint(tok.all_special_ids)
```
I'll tag the PR with `onboard/gpt-mini-v3` and link the config-validator logs.

sarah: thanks. pinging @eng-releases to schedule a minor rollout to staging after the PR is merged. include canary plan and rollback steps.

eng-releases: noted — please target release branch `staging/onboard-gpt-mini-v3`. we'll run a 5% canary, monitor tokenization error rate and inference diffs, and rollback if tokenization errors spike. attach config-validator log to the release ticket.

maya: perfect. action items: akshay -> attach issue with repro; jon -> open PR with config + loader remap + unit test; i'll run end-to-end inference sanity once PR merges. will post links here. :thumbsup:
